adjudication.adjudication_notes: Candidate HUNK-0001 in grub-core/lib/x86_64/setjmp.S was evaluated: change from 'xorq %rax, %rax' to 'xorl %eax, %eax'. In x86-64 architecture, writing to a 32-bit register (EAX) zero-extends to the full 64-bit register (RAX) per Intel/AMD architecture specification. The two instructions are semantically identical; the only difference is encoding size (3 bytes vs 2 bytes). No function signature, behavior, contract, or observable effect changes. Not a compatibility change.
adjudication.no_compatibility_reason: The change is a pure code size optimization with identical runtime semantics. x86-64 guarantees that xorl %eax, %eax clears all 64 bits of RAX, same as xorq %rax, %rax.
